mechanism_narrative: Declining WORKPLACES mobility over four consecutive weeks signals sustained workplace closure or remote-work entrenchment. This reduces commuter foot traffic and associated retail visits, driving RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES declined from -5.6% to -20.6% over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than or equal to the mean of the last 28 days despite WORKPLACES remaining below -15%.

evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL increased from 11.1% to 16.4% over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days increases despite RESIDENTIAL remaining above 15%.

candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -20% in current week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days increases or remains flat when TRANSIT is below -20%.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days rises above the prior 28-day mean when GROCERY_PHARM is above +8% and RETAIL_REC is below -14%.
